REVIEW_DECISION: REJECT
RISK_CLASS: high-impact
SUMMARY: Provenance classification can be bypassed for changes to live model-profile artifacts. The validator recognizes the profile schema and two contract documents, but not `docs/factory-ng/model-profiles/v1/`. Such changes can be labeled ordinary refactors and accepted with an unregistered non-Sol/Opus reviewer, despite routing and budget policy being Factory contracts.
FINDING: high|scripts/factory-ng-provenance-validate.py|FACTORY_CONTRACT_PATHS/PREFIXES omit docs/factory-ng/model-profiles/v1/|This permits Factory routing or token-budget changes to evade factory classification and required Sol/Opus governance.
REQUIRED_CHANGE: Classify every model-profile artifact change as change_class=factory; derive model_profile impact, derive token_cost_accounting/high_impact for budget or accounting changes, and add rejection fixtures for profile-path evasion.
COUNTEREXAMPLE: Change staged-baseline.json ordinary_target_effective_tokens, submit provenance as change_class=refactor and contract_change_scope=none with a Qwen review; the current relationship validator derives no contract impact and accepts it.
